description: Compact Oven 3 pc. Grilling and Baking Set includes 7 inch x 10 inch baking sheet, casserole pan, and broiling grill. Cook, broil or bake your favorite meals or cookies in your toaster oven, outdoor gas or electric grill, camp stove or RV stove with Nordic Wares Grill & Bake set. Sized for easy storage and small spaces this set can be used for both toaster ovens or regular ovens. With the non-stick surface cooking and cleaning are a breeze. Made in USA with imported rack. Interior cooking surface dimensions of the baking sheets is 6 x 8 inches and the maximum exterior dimensions are10 x 7 x 1.9 inches.

If you crave flexible cooking tools but space is an issue, consider the Nordic Ware three-piece grilling set. Made by the company that pioneered microwave cookware and other adaptable cooking tools, this set features a portable 7-by-10-inch baking sheet, a casserole/roast pan, and a broiling grill. The products fit both toaster ovens and conventional ovens, letting you toast, grill, or bake a variety of foods in your appliance of choice. The set is especially ideal for dorms, boats, RVs, offices, and other space-limited locations where stackable products are essential. Each piece is coated with a nonstick material that makes cleanup easy and efficient.

details.Product Care Instructions: Before initial use and after subsequent uses, hand wash with warm, soapy water. Dishwasher use is not recommended, as it may shorten the life of the nonstick coating on your pan.
